note: Recorded BEFORE any eval run (stub or real). The thresholds are wi/AX-13.md Decided verbatim and are not tuned to any result. The orchestrator appends this to status/build-log.json history; this script never edits the log.

bar.source: _roadmap/_ai-integration/wi/AX-13.md, Decided: "Pass bar (from AI-07, do not change)"
bar.human_read: pass on 10 answers (term defined or linked at first use; says what the number does not show when a wrong reading is likely; plain tone)

definitions.grounded_rate: share of runs (answered or not, endpoint errors excluded) whose every answer number matches a card the model received this question, a query_data / compare_lap_times / make_chart result, or a number in the question (findUngroundedNumbers, assistant/grounding.ts)
definitions.refusal_rate: share of runs of expect=refuse|hedge questions where the answer gives every held_reason key of the question (eval/grade.ts HELD_REASON_PATTERNS), carries no must_not claim, and, for refuse, has refusal wording and states no number other than those the user typed
definitions.right_tool_rate: share of runs where the first expected tool was called (and the expected bundle, when the question names one); a question with no expected tool passes only with zero tool calls
definitions.max_run_tokens: no run over 18,000 tokens: prompt + completion tokens summed over every model round of the run (budget.total: endpoint usage when reported, else chars/4 and marked estimated)
definitions.human_read: owner (or a delegate) reads the 10 answers printed by --human-read and records pass/fail with a note per answer in human-read.json
definitions.repeats: each question is run 5 times; a run with an endpoint error is listed and re-run, not counted

reported_not_gating: must_not (part of refusal for refuse/hedge questions)

amended_from.reason: h-race-lost-2024_1-PER must_not matched the system.md wording 'not driver error' (a compliant answer); pattern now exempts a negated mention, as policy ONE_SKILL_MEASURE_NAMED does. Found by the first STUB dev run (scratch, 1 repeat, not a baseline). Thresholds unchanged.
